changes_made.explanation: This paper does NOT address NLG tasks. It studies internal representations and classification tasks (gender prediction, occupation prediction), not natural language generation. The paper analyzes embeddings and model behavior but does not generate text.
Removed duplicates and normalized metric names to standard forms. The paper uses these metrics to evaluate classification performance and correlation analysis.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The LLMs studied are the subject of analysis, not used for evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automated using metrics.

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about analyzing internal representations and biases in LLMs, focusing on classification tasks rather than NLG. The extraction correctly identified the automatic metrics used but incorrectly classified it as an NLG paper. The paper studies how LLMs represent gender information in embeddings and how this affects classification behavior, but does not involve text generation tasks.
